RECITALS: A.Developer is the owner in fee title of certain lands identified on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Queens (the "Tax Map") as Block 490, Lots 1, 11 and 250; as Block 916, Lots 1 and 10; and as Block 913, Lot 100, which are more particularly described in buildings and improvements thereon,together with any future replacements,additions or alterations thereto, and any new Building constructed thereon being referred to hereinafter collectively, as“Developer's Property"). B.The State is the owner in fee title of certain lands underwater known as “Parcel 1","Parcel 2”and“Parcel 3”(said parcels,collectively,the“State’s Land"),as each such parcel is more particularly described and illustrated in on that certain“WaterfrontAreaMap,dated March 11,2015, and last revised September 17,2015(the“Tidal Map") annexed hereto as Exhibit B, which said lands abut and are adjacent to Developer's Land, as shown on the Tidal Map. C.Developer's Land and the State's Land are contiguous along a shared property line for a distance of at least 10 linear feet,which meets the definitional requirement of "zoning lot”under subdivision (d) of such definition as set forth in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (hereinafter defined). D.The New York City Housing Authority (the “Authority") is the owner in fee title of certain land,with the buildings and improvements thereon,identified on the Tax Map as Block 490, Lots 101, 102 and 50, which is more particularly described in Exhibit C annexed hereto (said lands being herein called, collectively,"Authority's Land"; and said lands, existing Buildings and improvements thereon, together with any future replacements,additions or alterations thereto,and any new Building constructed thereon,being referred to hereinafter, collectively,as"Authority's Property").
